text: You proceed to find the Eumanos who are still alive on the\nmainland. But you find out that the monsters who attack you\nare actually the Eumanos. Let's hurry to the village ruins!
Many Eumanos in the village ruins have been turned into\nmonsters. But there's still hope that you will find some\nsurvivors. Keep going further!
You reach the depths of the village ruins that has turned\ninto a ghost town. As Muti sinks into despair, a bizarre\nmonster appears. Beat and get rid of the dangerous Deformis!
